pump.description:
Pump status (may be absent if communication failed).

**Two incompatible shapes exist in production** and both must be
read. The 2025 spec described only the nested one:

- *Nested* (`pump.status.{bolusing,suspended,status,timestamp}`) —
  the shape this spec declared. Observed on 1 of 11 sites in the
  2026-04 corpus, in 10.5% of device statuses.
- *Flat* (`pump.{bolusing,suspended,secondsFromGMT,pumpID}`) —
  undeclared until now. Observed on **10 of 11 sites**, in 85.1% of
  device statuses.

The flat shape is the majority in practice and was entirely absent
from the spec. See
`docs/30-design/nightscout-typed-schema-evidence-2026-09-10.md` §4.3.
